senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) Elul, the sixth month of the Hebrew calendar, containing twenty nine days, varying between the seventh of August and the second of October.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:4">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בני א׳</he> animals born in Elul.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 14:37">Targ. Y. Num. XIV, 37</cite> <cite ref="A01280"><he>אילול</he></cite>. Targ. II Esth. III, 7.
